item.title: Olive Hills Apartments fire; all evacuated
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) -- Everyone was evacuated after a fire in Olive Hills Apartments in Drexel. According to the Montgomery County Regional Dispatch, the call for the fire came in at approximately 11:15 a.m. There are no reported injuries at this time. 2 NEWS is enroute and working to learn more.

item.title: Crews respond to dog attack on Forest Glen Avenue
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) -- Crews are responding to a dog bite mauling incident in the 50 block of Forest Glen Avenue. According to the Montgomery County Regional Dispatch, the call for the reported mutiple bites was made at approximately 11:15 a.m. 2 NEWS is working to learn more.
